transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello! I'm Dora, a clinical conversational agent. I conducted your follow-up check after your cataract surgery. Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can start with light exercise, such as gardening, about 1 week after surgery. Just be gentle and avoid anything too strenuous. It's also a good idea to wear protective eyewear while gardening.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for the advice. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You should start using the preservative-free eye drops four times a day to help with dryness.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Got it, thank you. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Some sensitivity to bright light is normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses. But if it's severe or causing a lot of discomfort, we'd recommend wearing sunglasses to help. If it's still a concern, you may want to speak with your care team about it.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for the reassurance. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's common to have some blurriness, especially in the first week after surgery. But it should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry or getting worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything is okay.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you so much for the information. I don't have any more questions right now.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It was my pleasure to help. Before we go, I just want to check: do you feel like all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery have been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, you've answered all my questions. Thank you for your help!
